title: OL-20261122-3: Unlearn's own repository waits on an org credential
body:
**Owner:** platform-engineer
**Trigger:** daily tenant-repos.yml run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation tenantrepos --probe unlearn
**Status:** closed

TENANT-REPO-1: all three routes in tenant-repos.yml (ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN, LANE_PAT, lane GitHub App) are unbound, so ultrastable/unlearn cannot be created. Recorded as gate tenant-repo-unlearn in doctrine/open-loops.json; default in effect: Unlearn deploys from instances/unlearn, the workflow retries daily.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-22T20:31:22Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
